summary: Host suite 118/122. Four failures: two sunset-bench tests (likely side effect of the new evening light/clock change, #288), a ball-play Stop check, and a Jump-in test where Play does not start the berry race. I did not explore further in this session, so causes are unconfirmed.

failures.what: Sprout does not walk to the lookout bench at 17.6 h (goal stays 'tend')
failures.steps: Run lookout.jl test 'At sunset Sprout walks to the lookout bench...' (clock set to 17.6 h)
failures.expected: Sprout sets off to the bench at sunset
failures.actual: Sprout kept goal :tend (check failed in 0.1 s)

failures.what: Nobody sits on the sunset bench within 60 s of 17:36
failures.steps: Run s51_play.jl 'Sunset bench: at dusk (20:00) nobody stays on the bench'
failures.expected: a critter sits down on the bench in the evening, leaves at dusk
failures.actual: nobody sat down within 60 s of 17:36. Possibly the bench schedule no longer matches the new light_phase (sunset moved later, #288)

failures.what: Ball play: a fetcher keeps chasing after Stop
failures.steps: Run minigames.jl 'Ball play: Sprout kicks the ball, a critter fetches it and passes it back'
failures.expected: after Stop no critter chases the ball
failures.actual: a fetcher is left chasing after Stop

failures.what: Jump in from the camera menu: Play does not start the berry race
failures.steps: Run s51_play.jl 'Jumped in: the camera menu switches orbit and follow...'
failures.expected: Play starts Jump in (BerryRace) so the camera menu can be tested
failures.actual: Play did not start Jump in (Main.Plugin_berry_race.BerryRace); may be left over state from the berry race changes (#289, #298)
